# Tutuu

> Tutuu is a web app for managing small construction crews — task assignment and tracking, material requests, tool tracking, attendance and salary calculation, photo documentation and PDF invoices, all in one place. Free to start, works on any phone.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tutuu.net/): Product overview, features and sign-up
- [Install guide](https://tutuu.net/install): How to add Tutuu to your home screen on iPhone and Android
